subject: [ bug report ] legend for colour or fill

messages.author: 223beb57ce203bde
messages.subject: [ bug report ] legend for colour or fill
parts:
Hi Hadley,

The color coding for value "0.3" is missing.

#######
require(ggplot2)
df <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10, z = c(0, 0.3))
qplot(x, y, fill = z, data = df, geom = 'tile')
qplot(x, y, colour = z, data = df)
########

ggplot2 version 0.8.8

Best Regards,
Xie Chao

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: [ bug report ] legend for colour or fill
parts:
this is because of precision of double:

> grid.pretty(c(0.0,0.3))==0.3
[1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE

probably it is so difficult to fix this kind of bugs.

the ad-hoc workaround is:

df <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10, z = c(0, 0.3+.Machine$double.eps))
qplot(x, y, fill = z, data = df, geom = 'tile')

messages.subject: Re: [ bug report ] legend for colour or fill
parts:
so, it seems we can wrap the grid.pretty function with signif:

########
require(ggplot2)
my.pretty <- grid.pretty
grid.pretty <- function(...) signif(my.pretty(...))

df <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = 1:10, z = c(0, 0.3))
qplot(x, y, fill = z, data = df, geom = 'tile')

Dear,

I am constructing a normal Quantile-quantile plot for the weight of babies (variable wt) by using stat_qq of ggplot2.
To this plot, I want to add a regression line (with 95 % confidence ) with stat_smooth by using the output variables "..theoretical.. " and "..sample..". It is not working. Can someone gives a suggestions how to solve this?

p <- ggplot(babies, aes(sample = wt))
plot3 <- p + stat_qq()


plot4 <- plot3 + stat_smooth(aes(x=..theoretical..,y=..sample..),method=lm, formula= y~x)


Thanks a lot,

An Carbonez
